prompt:
Create one new locked-state variant of the exact Vivhite game character-selection portrait shown in Image 1. Image 1 controls the exact framing, pose, scale and outer silhouette; Image 2 reinforces her exact hairstyle, round glasses and butterfly shape. Preserve the same centered near-front three-quarter bust, the complete butterfly and hair, both shoulders, chest-crystal crop, calm expression and narrow even safety margins. Do not redesign, rotate, zoom, recrop or change her proportions.

Change only the availability-state treatment. Render the whole character as a cohesive very dark charcoal and deep-navy silhouette with strongly reduced brightness and saturation. Retain only restrained low-contrast internal planes so the layered bob, round glasses rims, butterfly wings, high collar, shoulders and faceted chest pendant remain barely recognizable at 132 by 195 pixels. The butterfly may use muted midnight blue, the glasses may use dim antique bronze and the pendant may use a subdued dark violet; none may glow. Keep skin, white costume panels and hair deeply shadowed rather than bright. Use crisp controlled outer contours, solid near-opaque character materials and a clear disabled-character visual language. Lighting and color must end exactly at the physical character contours. One character only.

No painted material outside the character silhouette. No surrounding tone, radial field, vignette, halo, aura, rim haze, outer glow, bloom, atmospheric wash, particles, mist, detached color patch, scenery, floor or cast shadow. No rectangular field, decorative frame, border, backing plate, lock symbol, padlock, keyhole, chain, text, letters, numbers, logo, signature or watermark. No hands or raised arms. No sword, blade, dagger, staff, wand, rod, spear, spellbook, shield, held orb, held object or weapon. No long ribbon, white silk strip, bandage, helmet, heavy armor, extra ornament, extra person, extra face, extra eye, duplicated butterfly or malformed glasses.
